Ruling-ref: seat ruling (repo:objectstack#3, 2026-11-17 17:56Z) on this card's ask, option A

Scope (seat ruling A): each of the three SSO-user doors (import, add, remove) admits `organizationId` only when it equals the caller's session active organization, and refuses any other value with an error naming the mismatch, writing nothing; the body value never feeds scope, the session org stays the only scope source; the generic identity-route stamp stays. Pins: absent key accepted; equal key accepted and ignored for scope; a different org refused, nothing written; no active org in the session plus a body org refused; one other identity route keeps the stamp (control). Live console readings on showcase with `OS_CLOUD_MANAGED=1`. `Clause-②: yes` (each door admits one more key, constrained); seat L2 at the contract tier because it touches who can act on which org. Any path where the body org could reach scope ⇒ stop and report.

Lease `o3-D` (seat post #34584).
